attractions.name: Amazon Rainforest Exploration (Reserva Amazonica)
attractions.description: Amazon rainforest exploration from a jungle lodge with a-la-carte excursions to choose from

attractions.name: Canopy Tower, Refugio Amazonas
attractions.description: 30-metre tower rising above the rainforest canopy with panoramic views and good birdwatching for macaws, parrots and toucans.

attractions.name: Oxbow Lake
attractions.description: Calm lake for quiet boat exploration; depending on season, sightings may include giant river otters, kingfishers, black caimans, turtles and monkeys.

attractions.name: Camera Trap Feeding Stations, Refugio Amazonas
attractions.description: Feeding stations with hidden cameras that capture images of elusive rainforest animals; suitable for families and wildlife enthusiasts.

attractions.name: Lake Sandoval
attractions.description: Mirror-like oxbow lake in the Tambopata National Reserve, home to giant river otters; howler monkeys, red-bellied macaws, turtles and black caimans can be seen
attractions._source_file: South America/All Inclusive Guide - Peru- Neha and Mayur.pdf

attractions.name: Rainforest Canopy Platforms
attractions.description: Platforms 29 meters above the ground, walking from treetop to treetop; toucans, trogons and monkeys can be spotted
attractions._source_file: South America/All Inclusive Guide - Peru- Neha and Mayur.pdf

attractions.name: Anaconda Walk
attractions.description: 30-minute wooden bridge walk over the 'aguajales' flooded swamps where amphibians, birds and mammals can be seen
attractions._source_file: South America/All Inclusive Guide - Peru- Neha and Mayur.pdf

hotels.name: Reserva Amazonica
hotels.location: Amazon lodge, 45 min canoe ride from Puerto Maldonado airport

hotels.name: Refugio Amazonas Lodge
hotels.location: Buffer zone of Tambopata National Reserve, reached by road and river from Puerto Maldonado

safety_tips.tip: Wear long sleeves in the early morning and evening and apply mosquito repellent regularly in the Amazon
Always follow the naturalist guide's instructions and never wander off marked trails without a guide

connectivity_tips.tip: Mobile coverage is extremely limited at Refugio Amazonas; expect little to no signal
Wi-Fi at Refugio Amazonas Lodge is available only in common areas
Electricity at Refugio Amazonas is available only during three scheduled periods daily; charge devices when power is on and bring a power bank

transport_options.description: 45 min canoe ride between Puerto Maldonado airport and the Reserva Amazonica lodge

transport_options.mode: Road and river transfer to Refugio Amazonas Lodge
transport_options.description: Road transfer followed by a motorised canoe journey along the Tambopata River to the lodge.
transport_options.how_to_use: Lodge luggage allowance is one piece up to 15 kg per guest; larger luggage can be stored securely. Keep passport, medication, camera, a change of clothes and valuables in a day bag.

health_tips.tip: Yellow fever vaccine is strongly recommended for trips to the Amazon (Puerto Maldonado or Iquitos)
Yellow fever vaccine is strongly recommended for the Amazon
health_tips._source_file: South America/All Inclusive Guide - Peru- Neha and Mayur.pdf

health_tips.tip: Use insect repellent and wear long sleeves for mosquito protection in the Amazon
health_tips._source_file: South America/All Inclusive Guide - Peru- Neha and Mayur.pdf

season_notes.tip: Pack long-sleeve breathable shirts, lightweight long pants, rain poncho, insect repellent and a headlamp for the Amazon
Bring a rain poncho or waterproof jacket and a dry bag to protect electronics from humidity
season_notes._source_file: South America/All Inclusive Guide - Peru- Neha and Mayur.pdf
